snippet.title: S.T.A.R.V.E. - Farming Roguelike Deckbuilder - Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
Farm or get fired.

S.T.A.R.V.E. is a grid-based farming roguelike deckbuilder. The corporation sends you to alien planets to hit quotas that never stop rising. Build card combos and harvest everything you can!

🌱 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4039860/STARVE_Farming_Roguelike_Deckbuilder/

💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.wegfreund.games

🌐 Website: https://wegfreund.games
